_comment: This file is an EXAMPLE TEMPLATE showing how to write custom validation rules.
When --rule_config is not supplied, the built-in rules run automatically.
When --rule_config IS supplied, only the rules defined in this file run —
built-in rules are replaced entirely by whatever you list here.
Copy this file, adapt the examples to your model, and pass the path via
--rule_config when running validate_encoding.
description: Example custom rule configuration — annotated template for customers

_comment: EXAMPLE 1: Match tensors by name pattern and enforce a specific bitwidth.
tensor_name_pattern is a case-insensitive Python regex applied to the full tensor name.
tensor_type restricts the rule to 'weight', 'bias', or 'activation' tensors.
validation_rules.name: attention_weights_4bit_symmetric
validation_rules.description: Attention weights must use 4-bit symmetric quantization

_comment: EXAMPLE 2: Match tensors by layer type keyword and enforce bitwidth + symmetry.
layer_types is a list of keywords; the rule applies when the tensor name contains
at least one of them (case-insensitive).
validation_rules.name: embedding_weights_8bit_asymmetric
validation_rules.description: Embedding weights must use 8-bit asymmetric quantization

_comment: EXAMPLE 3: Enforce per-channel quantization by requiring more than one channel.
min_channels: 2 means the tensor must have at least 2 quantization channels,
i.e. per-channel (not per-tensor) quantization.
validation_rules.name: linear_weights_per_channel
validation_rules.description: Linear layer weights must use per-channel quantization

_comment: EXAMPLE 4: Validate that quantization scales fall within an expected range.
scale_range min and max are inclusive bounds on each per-channel scale value.
Use this to catch tensors whose scales are unexpectedly large or small.
validation_rules.name: conv_weight_scale_range
validation_rules.description: Convolution weight scales must be in [0.001, 0.1]

_comment: EXAMPLE 5: Combine a name pattern with a layer-type list (AND logic).
Both conditions must be satisfied for the rule to apply to a tensor.
Set enabled to false to suppress a rule without deleting it.
validation_rules.name: lm_head_weights_4bit
validation_rules.description: LM-head weights must use 4-bit quantization — disabled in this example

_comment: EXAMPLE 6: Context-aware custom rule — requires --dlc_file_path so the tool
can traverse the graph and identify the predecessor of each activation tensor.
Use offset_range to verify that quantization zero-points are within bounds.
context_aware_rules.name: activation_offset_range
context_aware_rules.description: Activation tensor offsets must be in [-128, 127] (int8 range)
